description: Phase 14: 2x2 spatial reasoning. Fixture has four coloured shapes — red square (top-left), blue circle (top-right), green triangle (bottom-left), yellow star (bottom-right). The prompt asks for the colour in the top-right; correct answer must contain 'blue'.

image_fixture.license: Luak-owned synthetic; no real PII; generated by scripts/generate-vision-fixtures.py (phase14 v1)
image_fixture.notes: Synthetic 2x2 quadrant. TL red square, TR blue circle, BL green triangle, BR yellow star.

questions.question: Look at the four shapes in the image. What colour is the shape in the top-right quadrant? Answer with one word.

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for spatial relation recognition. Pass requires 'blue' substring in answer, which discriminates top-right from the other 3 colours.

known_scoring_limitations: Bare substring 'blue' would PASS even if a model named all four colours. The 80-char max_chars cap restricts model answers to a short colour-name so the substring is discriminative within the budget.
